name: 36165-specdecode-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (target) + unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct (draft). Ungated mirrors of the Meta checkpoints; same weights, not substitutions.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. 18.6 GB of weights fits one card.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, warmup 15%, bounded at 200 requests.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, FIXED SHAPE: 128 prompt tokens and 256 output tokens with zero variance, greedy decoding (temperature 0).
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter chat assistant with a small draft model, serving four concurrent short prompts on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line.

# Ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. A mirror, not a substitution.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

# Draft is the ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct.
speculative-config: {"model": "unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct", "num_speculative_tokens": 3}

compilation-config: {"cudagraph_mode": "FULL"}
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
